letter.subject: Release the Xpert cartridge cost audit
letter.body:
Danaher—

I’m reaching out to you out of concern for the millions of people living with dangerous diseases who do not receive a diagnosis. Your GeneXpert machines can diagnose Ebola, HIV, extensively drug-resistant TB, hepatitis, and many common sexually transmitted infections, but they are out of reach to the people who need them most because of unreasonably high prices.

Independent research has shown that you can make a fair profit at $5 per test, which would allow governments and organizations to scale up testing. These tests currently cost $15-$20, which is too expensive for many who need them. Millions of people continue to die of treatable diseases and your tests could help change that.

In September of 2023, you made a commitment to have the actual cost of your MTR/RIF Xpert cartridges validated with a third-party assessment, and to release these results publicly. Over two years later, this still has not happened, and you have ignored deadlines set by the people interested in increasing access to your crucial tests. All research available continues to show that your tests are sold for far above the cost to produce them.

I urge you to show your commitment to putting people over profits by fulfilling your promise to annually audit TB test prices. Please release this audit immediately to help save lives.

Regards,
[Your name]

actions.title: Contact your MP about TB funding
actions.blurb: Ask your Member of Parliament to back funding for the global TB response.
actions.weeklyNudge: Set a weekly reminder — repeated contact from constituents is what moves MPs.

letter.subject: Please join the APPG on Global Tuberculosis
letter.body:
Dear {{mp_name}},

I am writing as your constituent in {{constituency}}.

Tuberculosis is now the world’s deadliest infectious disease, and it is rising here in the UK too. It is preventable and curable, yet it still kills more than a million people a year worldwide.

{{ask}}

Yours sincerely,
letter.ask:
Parliament’s All-Party Parliamentary Group on Global Tuberculosis works to push the Government to improve its TB policies and commit more resources to ending the epidemic. In March 2026, it published the findings of an inquiry into rising TB rates in the UK.

If you are not already a member, I am asking you to join the All-Party Parliamentary Group on Global Tuberculosis, and to support its recommendations for strengthening the UK’s response to TB.

abstentionist.card_note: Your MP is a member of Sinn Féin, whose MPs do not take their seats in the House of Commons. This message asks them to raise TB funding with UK ministers directly.
abstentionist.ask: I am asking you to write to the Foreign Secretary and the Minister for Development urging the UK to protect its funding for the global TB response, including its £850 million pledge to the Global Fund, as the aid budget is cut.
